intro.label: Pocket
intro.body: Kick on 1 and 3, hats on the 8ths. Bass waits two bars, then plants E on beat 1. This is a backbeat, not four-on-the-floor.

intro.label: Figure
intro.body: Lit pitches are E · E (E). They match the MIDI stem.

intro.label: Harmony
intro.body: Intro is Em (i) — the same symbols as the main chord-name row. Bass roots those changes.

intro.label: Missable
intro.body: Easy miss in Intro (bars 0–3): ornamenting past the written line. Play the MIDI pocket before adding notes.

v1.label: Pocket

v1.label: Figure

v1.label: Harmony
